name: Kinjo no Super Sentou wa Onna no Ko no Hadaka Mihoudai
original_name: 近所のスーパー銭湯は女の子の裸 見放題
source:
A girl is taken by her father into the male side of a bathhouse.
She is developing but she isn't shy to be seen. An illustration novel depicting a naked girl in the male side of a bathhouse.
